This Resume has an ATS score of more than 93

I have personally used this similar single-column resume in my job hunting and got amazing results

I’m sharing a resume template where you can create your resume quickly and easily: 
https://lnkd.in/g6zgbx-R

📍 Kindly like and #repost your Jobseeker friends it is useful for others

Tips Do’s and Don’ts for a Winning Resume:
✔️ Do’s:
✔️ Define your job search goal and tailor your resume.
✔️ Use industry buzzwords to match the job description.
✔️ Highlight achievements with numbers and metrics.
✔️ Keep a clean, consistent format.
✔️ Prioritize relevant experiences and list them in reverse chronological order.
✔️ Proofread and get feedback.

❌ Don’ts:
❌ Use generic templates or vague claims.
❌ Misrepresent your GPA, skills, or accomplishments.
❌ Include lengthy objective statements or references on your resume.
❌ Exceed two pages—one page for most students.
❌ Rely on one application—apply broadly!
